name: app
note: source/app is the app's own production build (npm run build in toyz-loop); it is not committed. The same screens are live at https://loop.toyz.kr. The app's first-run sample (four routines, the example crew 새벽 루프 with three fictional members) is used; today's check-in list is captured at three moments: as it opens (1 of 3 done), after 물 8잔 is counted up to 8 (2 of 3), and after 책 20쪽 is checked (3 of 3). The chrome ring, the date and the wordmark are drawn in the reel from the app's own code (Rings.tsx, App.tsx, app.css).
